faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our pricing
faq.changePlanQuestion: Can I change my plan anytime?
faq.changePlanAnswer: Yes. Upgrades take effect right away, with a credit for the unused part of your current period. Downgrades take effect at your next renewal.
faq.downgradeDataQuestion: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
faq.downgradeDataAnswer: Your data remains safe. If you exceed the limits of a lower plan, you'll have read-only access to the excess data until you upgrade again or reduce usage.
faq.refundsAnswer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for annual plans. Monthly subscriptions can be canceled anytime without penalty.
faq.setupFeeAnswer: No, there are no setup fees or hidden charges. You only pay for the plan you choose.
faq.teamsQuestion: How does billing work for teams?
faq.teamsAnswer: Team plans are billed per organization. All members within the organization share the plan limits and features.
faq.trialQuestion: Can I try before I buy?
faq.trialAnswer: Yes! Start with our free plan to explore the basics, then upgrade when you're ready for more advanced features.
